title: The Emigrants
writer: Bengt Forslund, Jan Troell, Vilhelm Moberg
actors: Max von Sydow, Liv Ullmann, Eddie Axberg
plot: An 1840s Swedish farming family struggle with their unyielding land and decide to embark on the arduous journey to new hope in America.
awards: Nominated for 5 Oscars. 8 wins & 11 nominations total
